display.purpose: Live watts. The largest type on the ride screen.

title.purpose: Session name in History and on the calendar.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: The device menu that opens over the page. Nothing else casts a shadow.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Border, fill, and opacity on buttons.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: When the rider prefers reduced motion, transitions and animations collapse.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action. Start, resume, connect.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-text); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 85%, black); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default action. White panel, steel border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, var(--border)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Stop. Pale red wash, red ink, never a filled brand red.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { appearance: none; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 55%, var(--border)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 16%, var(--panel)); color: var(--danger-text); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { border-color: var(--danger); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inset fill and a steel line. No glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--code-bg); color: var(--text); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; min-width: 12rem; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: The only app navigation. Active state is an inset cobalt underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="App sections"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active" type="button">Ride</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Devices</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">History</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Calendar</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Profile</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; width: 100%; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; appearance: none; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 transparent; color: var(--text); opacity: 0.55; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { opacity: 0.85; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 80%, var(--accent)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab-active { opacity: 1; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: White surface on cool paper, separated by a steel line.
components.html:
History

Past rides, with the power you held.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.85rem 1rem; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-panel-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.45; max-width: 42rem; }

components.name: Warning Banner
components.description: Amber wash and amber ink. Status, not decoration.
components.html: Trainer link lost. Readings stay until you reconnect.
components.css: .ds-banner-warn { margin: 0; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 18%, transparent); color: var(--warn-text); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.85rem; }

components.name: Live Watts
components.description: The hero reading. Metric cobalt while fresh, slate when stale.
components.css: .ds-power { text-align: center; padding: 1.5rem 1rem 1.65rem; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-power-hint { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-power-value { margin: 0.2rem 0 0; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: clamp(3.75rem, 17vw, 6.25rem); font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.95; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.045em; color: var(--metric); } .ds-power-unit { margin-left: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.35em; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); vertical-align: super; }

components.name: Sensor Status
components.description: A word and a dot. Green means connected. No filled chip.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.28rem; padding: 0.1rem 0; border: none; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); } .ds-pill-dot { width: 0.35rem; height: 0.35rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok); } .ds-pill-state { text-transform: lowercase; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.7rem; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Session Figure
components.description: A quiet label over a heavy mono number.
components.css: .ds-metric { display: grid; gap: 0.18rem; min-width: 4.25rem; margin: 0; } .ds-metric dt { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-metric dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--text); }

narrative.overview:
OpenTrainer is a paper instrument meant to be read from the bike. The ground is cool and light. White panels sit on it inside a steel line. Live watts are the only type allowed to shout. Everything else stays quiet so that number can be read at a glance under ordinary room light.

The climate is light only and does not follow the operating system. At rest the screen is a centered column: a tab bar, then stacked panels. When a ride is in progress the column opens wide and the chrome tightens. Controls are compact, slightly rounded, and bordered. Figures are a second voice: heavy monospace, tabular, and metric cobalt while the reading is live.

The system rejects a dim instrument theater, a warm cream studio, and harsh pure black on pure white. Green, amber, and red report state. Cobalt is the only interactive accent.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, white panels, steel borders
Live watts as the largest type, in heavy monospace
One cobalt accent; green, amber, and red stay status
Flat at rest; a shadow only when a layer floats
Compact bordered controls that stay quieter than the numbers

rules.name: The Paper Climate Rule
rules.body: The cockpit stays light (`color-scheme: light`). It does not follow the operating system, and it does not grow a dark theme.

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red report connection, warning, error, and calendar ride state (amber for scheduled, green for completed). They are not decoration and they are not the primary action.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only interactive accent. Metric cobalt is that same hue used for live numbers, not a second brand color.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Source Sans 3 carries labels and prose. Source Code Pro carries watts, durations, and any figure a rider compares. A live number is never set in the sans face.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: On the ride screen the live watt figure is the largest type. No headline competes with it.

rules.name: The Ride-Opens Rule
rules.body: Resting screens stay in the centered column. A ride in progress may go wide and shorten the padding. Do not keep the resting margins once the workout is running.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only when a layer floats over the page. Panels, cards, and buttons do not carry a resting shadow.

rules.name: The One Corner Rule
rules.body: Controls, panels, inputs, and banners use a 0.4rem corner. Do not add a pill button or a sharp rectangle beside that corner.

dos: Do keep the cockpit light-only, on Cool Paper (`#f4f6f8`) with Ink (`#121417`).
Do use Cobalt (`#1b4fd8`) for the primary action, the active tab underline, links, and today on the calendar.
Do set live watts and compared figures in Source Code Pro, weight 800, tabular numerals, Metric Cobalt (`#153db8`) when fresh.
Do draw panels and controls with a 1px Steel Line (`#9aa8b5`) and a 0.4rem corner.
Do mark connection and errors with Signal Green, Signal Amber, and Signal Red, including the small calendar dots.
donts: Don't add a dark theme or follow the OS appearance.
Don't use green, amber, or red as a brand accent or a primary button.
Don't put a resting shadow on panels, cards, or buttons.
Don't set live watts in Source Sans 3, or let a page title outsize them on the ride screen.
Don't introduce a second accent, a pill radius, or pure black on pure white.
